description.value:
You focus on the moments you have experienced, and the moments others in the place you are have experienced, feeling a twinge of a connection. Some of these memories are yours, but they are also not truly yours – they are those whose lives your soul is connected to. You can cast Retrocognition at 7th rank once per day as an innate occult spell. If you witness a traumatic or turbulent event that pertains to or is similar to a memory of someone in a past life of yours, the GM can grant the Will save DC an adjustment to be Easy or Very Easy, whichever is appropriate.

Special If you have the Curse of Secrets feat and you have never broken it, your devotion allows you to cast this spell at 8th or 9th rank instead.
